title: Cloud City: Case Study: EHR Healthcare — HIPAA, Legacy DB & Cloud Migration
city_concept: City Hospital Network & Secure Medical Archives

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Regional clinics were couriering paper patient charts in unlocked wagons, losing charts and violating patient privacy laws.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Chief Physician Paul built a pneumatic tube network (Apigee & Private VPC) connecting clinics to the Central Medical Vault.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: When a clinic sent an unsealed request, the pneumatic valve rejected the capsule and alerted the Medical Board.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Pneumatic tubes are limited by physical air pressure; cloud APIs securely transmit millions of encrypted health records globally.
